text: 📸 Inauguración de Bachillerato Nacional — Tijuana, Baja California

🇲🇽🏭 Public high school on the border — with an AI career track. CBTIS No. 290 in Tijuana now offers a specialization in Artificial Intelligence. Universidad Rosario Castellanos is also operating in Baja California. The state's public-education pipeline now runs uninterrupted from preschool to applied AI engineering — all free. — Inauguration of National Preparatory, Tijuana, Baja California Built on the border the empire pretends is a wasteland.

🇲🇽✊ "Education is a right, not a privilege." "And we will keep building preparatory schools close to home." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, inauguration of National Preparatory, Tijuana 200,000 new upper-secondary spaces nationwide under the National Preparatory program — a direct answer to the neoliberal-era shutdown of public high school access. The first generation includes the new "Margarita Maza" prep model.

🇲🇽🎨 "Be proud you are Mexican. We live in a great country." "Mexico — and not every country in the world has this — has original cultures, original peoples. Did you know the Maya invented zero? Without zero there is no mathematics, no computers, no rockets to the moon." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, addressing schoolchildren, Tijuana On the border with the United States, the president told kids their inheritance is older than any empire to the north. Indigenous Mexico built the foundations of modern science.

🇲🇽✊ "It's better to support all of them, so every kid arrives at school on equal footing." "You can't grade a child who didn't have breakfast the same as one who did. There are kids in homes with violence, in homes without food. We don't know what each child is carrying." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Rita Cetina rollout, Tijuana Sheinbaum to teachers in Baja California: the program isn't about merit. It's about equity. Universal cash support so hunger and home stress don't decide which kids fall behind.

🇲🇽✊ Universal scholarship: 9 million kids, no exceptions. "This Scholarship is for every girl and boy in Mexico who goes to public school — about 8 or 9 million children." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Rita Cetina Scholarship rollout, Tijuana Rolled out today in Baja California: Beca Rita Cetina now reaches all primary school students nationwide. Cash support for school supplies, uniforms and shoes, paid directly to mothers. No income screening, no merit test. Public school = entitlement.

🐉🇲🇽 How the Belt & Road enters Mexico: through Michoacán's governor

China's ambassador Chen Daojiang met Governor Alfredo Ramírez Bedolla on June 5 to "materialize cooperation" at Lázaro Cárdenas — Mexico's second-largest port and the country's main maritime gateway for trade with China. The plan: expand port capacity and commercialize Michoacán's designation-of-origin products into Chinese markets.

Bedolla also announced that in July 2026, Morelia will open bidding to acquire Chinese-made hybrid buses for the Morebús transit system. Concrete BRI infrastructure entering Mexico not through CDMX but through subnational diplomacy — exactly the channel Washington has no leverage to close.

While the US screams about Chinese investment, Mexican governors are signing memorandums. Mexico is diversifying one port, one bus fleet at a time.
